text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the time has finally come...
Is your blood boiling!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san is trembling, saying,
"The ghost's ruckus has reached its peak"... but! That ends today!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Towards our showdown... let us go!!
Princess of the Burning Heart! Our invincible~?

text_block_list.name: Ghost Extermination Squad
text_block_list.text: Ghost Extermination Squaad!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gah, that light just now...
Is someone nearby?

text_block_list.name: Dignified Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, Team A is right here!
That's just the light from our team's flashlight.
Please continue your search!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Rogeeer.
Then classroom team, keep searching here as planned—

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"3rd Floor Search Team here~!
We just heard a suspicious noise, so we're pursuing it~!"

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoops... roger! Anyone nearby,
make sure you don't collide with the runners!
...Hehe, won't make the same mistake twice~"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, simply splendid!
Information is pouring in steadily~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Alright everyone, let's regroup once!"
...We'll assess the situation back at the dorm, Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...? Nature-san, whatever is the matter?
You look just like a princess trying natto for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, nothing really~?
Just deeply thinking about how much you've changed, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like that tea party earlier,
or how you gave orders to organize the situation just now...
What happened? Did something inspire you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes!
Pearl-san told me all about it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
About the path King-san walked
in order to cheer me on...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And then I realized!
The source of that heart-stirring cheer that day,
and the smiles on everyone's faces—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Was the culmination of King-san's hard work!
Listening to everyone's voices to stand beside them, being considerate.
A jewel of trust polished so we could fight together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If so, then I too—
Must stand beside everyone, and fight alongside them.
That's what I thought, and how I chose to act.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After all, I already know
that combining our strength brings success♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...So cheering wasn't the only thing
you received from King back then.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, thanks for the intel, everyone.
Classrooms, hallways, the stage...
So those are the spots where the ghost was felt.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Things falling on their own,
hearing battle cries,
poltergeist phenomena... right!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: H-How... How could this be...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was right next to all of those places!
To think I didn't even notice, let alone catch it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ............Wait, next to them?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ha!? A presence!
CHESTOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CRASH! Clatter clatter...*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooooogh!!
Ghost! Tremble before my battle cry
and show yourself, damn it all!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Not here, not here either!
Hiding won't do you any good~!
I'll search every last corner~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, Kawakami.
What were you doing when King and I saw the ghost?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Let me see~.
If I recall, I was helping make signboards...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah yes, I messed up big time!
I ended up pouring red paint all over my head!
So I panicked and...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pan... icked...
and went to the dorm... to take a shower...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It was meeeee!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, a certain rumor began circulating frequently.
Though Kawakami Princess had caused a massive uproar,
it seemed the impact she had on those around her was profound.

text_block_list.name: Commuting Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear about the Ritto Dorm ghost?
Turns out it was nothing after all. What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But even if something happens next time, we'll be fine!
The importance of joining forces... and how amazing it is,
Kawakami-chan taught us all about it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good for you, Kawakami.
All's well that ends well. Everything's wrapped up neatly—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? But wait...
What was that mysterious glow when she punched a hole in the dorm wall...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...N-No way, right~...?
